title: SetsAuthorityArcCommitment
description: Payload shape for a Mishpat::Commitment entry with action='sets-authority-arc'. A bounded, revocable grant of authority to set a node's conductor authority-arc factor — the memory<->resilience trade. The deployed lever is {0,1} (full authority anchor vs accountable leecher; there is no fractional arc until kitsune2 sharding lands — spike verdict, spec genesis/docs/superpowers/specs/2026-06-13-conductor-authority-arc-auto-policy.md §2). Source of truth: Holochain DHT (Mishpat zome, existing Commitment entry type — no new entry type; the action discriminator distinguishes; COORDINATOR-validated, so adding it is DNA-hash-neutral and hot-swappable). Canon: rea-compute-commitment-primitive.md. The grant validity window is valid_from/valid_until; the storage-side actuator (services::arc_actuator) enforces expiry + the LIVE mesh-coverage gate at actuation time (the zome cannot see live peer count).

action.description: Action discriminator. Fixed at 'sets-authority-arc' for this commitment kind.

scope.description: The node/agent whose authority arc this grant governs (CID or agent identifier).

provider.description: CID or agent identifier granting the authority — typically the node's operator/steward.

recipient.description: CID or agent identifier receiving the authority — the node itself, its Auto policy, or an on-device agent. Blast radius = exactly this revocable grant.

bounds.description: Enforceable bounds the storage-side actuator validates before any arc change.

knob.description: The only knob this action grants. Fixed — a new knob gets its own action discriminator.

min_factor.description: Minimum arc factor the grant permits. {0,1} only — the deployed lever (no fractional arc; holochain_p2p hard-clamps >1, spec §2).

max_factor.description: Maximum arc factor the grant permits. Must be >= min_factor.

coverage_floor.description: The per-key redundancy floor the grant pins. The actuator REFUSES a leecher that would drop remaining mesh coverage below this — never opens a keyspace gap (spec §4).

valid_from.description: ISO 8601 datetime when this grant becomes effective.

valid_until.description: ISO 8601 datetime when this grant expires. The actuator enforces expiry at actuation time.
